params.body:
Clients had a share of each year's revenue; suppliers had only a project count. A project count says little about a supplier: the waste site is on every project and a quarry on one, while the money goes the other way. This adds each supplier's share of what GLK buys, read the same way as the revenue share.

## Sync

- `RelationSource::purchaseInvoices($since)`: per purchase invoice the supplier (`address_id`) and the total excluding VAT (`amountexclvat_total`). The field names come from Bouwsoft's field listing for `PurchaseInvoices` and have not been read from real rows yet.
- Stored as links with source `aankoopfactuur`, role `leverancier`, no project, with the amount. Every invoice counts, like sales invoices.
- The whole invoice counts, also when nothing on it is booked on a project (fuel, insurance, rent). A supplier that sends invoices but is on no project now shows up in Contacten under Leveranciers with 0 projects.
- The sync still reads everything before it writes. If Bouwsoft refuses the field, the run fails and yesterday's network stays in place.

## Page

- The tab "Aandeel in omzet" becomes "Omzet en aankoop", with a switch between "Klanten in de omzet" and "Leveranciers in de aankopen". It has the same table, the top-5 and top-10 line, and `aandeel=aankoop` in the URL.
- In Contacten the column "Omzet" becomes "Aandeel". For a client it shows the revenue share and for a supplier the purchase share, per main role. A new sort option is "Grootste aandeel".
- The side panel shows "Aandeel in de aankopen" per year next to the revenue share.
- As before, money only appears as a share of a year, never as an amount. The intro sentence says so.

## Code

- `Network::revenue()` and the new `Network::purchases()` share one `shares($from, $source)`.
- The `purchases` computed property is cached until the next sync, like revenue. `share($contact)` builds its index once per request.

## Tests

- `test_each_supplier_has_a_share_of_each_years_purchases`:
  - 75/25 split between two suppliers, one of them with a fuel bill on no project;
  - revenue untouched;
  - the tab switch;
  - the Contacten column;
  - sorting by share.
- Full suite 232/232, JS 13/13, pint clean.
- Checked in headless Chromium on a copy of the production-size database with generated purchase invoices.

After merge: run `php artisan relations:sync` once on the server so the purchase invoices come in, or wait for the nightly run.
